svg.text: Read the Detect toast. It is the diagnosis.
Two messages, two rooms. Do not mix them up.
TOAST A · THE BRIDGE
Printer helper is not running on this PC.
Download it first, then detect.
The helper never clocked in.
On this till PC, open http://127.0.0.1:19500/health
If that page fails: open Cashier ’ Receipts on screen ’ Connect a printer.
Download the Print Bridge from that chip  not from Settings, not from WhatsApp.
Unzip, run Install-Palmart-Print-Bridge.cmd, then Detect again.
Windows 7 uses the Win7 installer. macOS and Linux have their own files on the same chip.
TOAST B · THE QUEUE
No print queues found.
Or you only see Fax / Microsoft Print to PDF.
The bridge is fine. Windows never hired the printer.
Printers & scanners ’ Add a printer ’ The printer that I want isnt listed
Local printer ’ port USB001 (or the COM port from Device Manager)
Driver Generic / Text Only · name it Xprinter · set Online
Then Detect again. Until that name sits under Printers & scanners, Detect is blind.
Device Manager showing USB Printing Support is not a queue. Do not keep tapping Detect.
